intro.title: Dead Internet
intro.tagline: Everyone is online. Nobody is real.

messages.ask: What can you tell me about {name}?

dana.noTrust: I don't know you. Show me you know something first.
dana.strong: "{claim}": two independent sources. I can stand behind that.
dana.weak: "{claim}": one source. That's a lead, not a story. Find me a second, independent one.
dana.none: "{claim}": nothing you've shown me backs this up. Cut it or find something.
dana.bold: "{claim}": that's a big claim. Big claims need more than this.

errors.unknown_topic: You don't know enough about that to ask.

time.sleepExplain: The world moves on one day while you sleep. By morning, messages, news, documents and events may have changed.
time.sleepStay: Reading, searching and browsing never use up time. Only sleeping does.

tips.introLead: Everything you find, you find here: the web, social media, messages and the news. Nobody will tell you what matters.
introPoints: Tap a name, a word, a date or an image to see what you can do with it.
Save what you find to your Casebook. Build theories from it and see how many independent sources back them.
Message people, ask them about what you have looked into, and show them what you have saved.
Time only moves when you sleep. Messages, news and pages can change overnight.
When your sources hold, publish. Nobody tells you if you are right.
tips.settingsReset: Show tips again from the start
tips.settingsHint: Tips appear once, the first time you use something. They never mention people, places or cases.

read.title: Everything can be tapped
read.text: Tap a name, a word or a date to see what you can do with it. Press and hold to select a phrase.

image.title: Images have their own tools
image.text: Look at an image's metadata, search for other copies of it, or flip it and search again.

search.title: Searching
search.text: Short searches work best. Put words in "quotes" for an exact phrase. Pages that have changed or gone may still be in the cache.

save.title: Saved to your Casebook
save.text: What you save starts unclassified. You decide which case it belongs to, if any.

message.title: Talking to people
message.text: Ask about something you have looked into, or show something from your Casebook. People answer in their own way, and not always truthfully.

theory.title: Theories
theory.text: A theory says who did what. Link evidence to it. The Casebook counts your independent sources. It cannot tell you whether you are right.

report.title: Publishing
report.text: Publishing cannot be undone. Each channel has its own standards, and the world reacts to what you publish, true or not.

sleep.title: Time
sleep.text: The day only ends when you choose to sleep. Dates you have learnt about are listed on the home screen.

outcome.title: A turn in the case
outcome.text: Something you did has changed how the case stands. It is in the Casebook under Reports. You can keep investigating.
